A: policy_name: Waste Management National Policy, 2079 (फोहरमैला व्यवस्थापन राष्ट्रीय नीति, २०७९)
D: policy_objective: To ensure citizens' right to live in a clean and healthy environment through sustainable waste management (Section 7, Goal).
